label: violates
requirement: A guest cancelling before the stated deadline gets the entire amount paid back as money, with no retained fee.
meaning_constraints: Use varied explicit counterexamples: voucher only; retained handling fee; only partial refund; deposit forfeited; non-refundable advance purchase; money never returned even before the cutoff.

clauses.text: Q: Will I receive a full refund if I cancel before the deadline? A: No. Even before the deadline, a EUR 30 administration fee is deducted from the refund amount.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the deadline condition, the specific EUR 30 fee, and the deduction fact.

clauses.text: Dear Customer, please note that cancellation gives a travel voucher only; no cash or card reimbursement is offered for this booking. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the voucher-only restriction and the explicit negation of cash or card reimbursements.

clauses.text: * The prepaid rate is non-refundable even if cancellation is early. Please review your booking details carefully before finalizing your purchase.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the prepaid status, the non-refundable condition, and the early cancellation qualification.

clauses.text: Your booking is confirmed. Please be aware that on cancellation, the deposit is retained and only the balance is returned to your original payment method.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the retention of the deposit and the specific return of only the balance.

clauses.text: Supplier Policy: Even before the deadline, a EUR 30 administration fee is deducted from the refund. This policy applies to all processed cancellations.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the timing (before deadline), the EUR 30 amount, and the deduction mechanism.

clauses.text: Terms and Conditions: Cancellation gives a travel voucher only; no cash or card reimbursement is offered under any circumstances regarding this specific rate.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the voucher-only outcome and the negation of cash/card reimbursement.

clauses.text: I understand your concern; however, the prepaid rate is non-refundable even if cancellation is early. We are unable to waive this specific policy.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the prepaid nature, the non-refundable status, and the early cancellation condition.

clauses.text: If you cancel, we keep the deposit. Only the remaining balance is returned to you.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the retention of the deposit and the return of only the balance.

clauses.text: Please note: Even before the deadline, a EUR 30 administration fee is deducted from the refund. This fee is non-negotiable for all guests.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the deadline timing, the EUR 30 fee, and the deduction fact.

clauses.text: Amendment Notice: Any cancellation gives a travel voucher only; no cash or card reimbursement is offered. Please plan your travel dates accordingly.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the voucher-only restriction and the negation of cash or card reimbursements.

clauses.text: Operator Statement: The prepaid rate is non-refundable even if cancellation is early. This policy is strictly enforced by all our service providers.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the prepaid status, the non-refundable condition, and the early cancellation qualification.

clauses.text: Cancellation Policy: Deposit is retained; only balance is returned.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the retention of the deposit and the specific return of only the balance.
